facts.statement: Zosuchus is a basal crocodyliform genus from the Late Cretaceous period found in Mongolia.
facts.quote: Zosuchus ("Zos [Canyon] crocodile") is a genus of basal, Late Cretaceous crocodyliform from Mongolia.

facts.statement: Zosuchus possessed a very short snout.
facts.quote: Este género poseía un hocico muy corto.

facts.statement: The fossil was discovered in the Redbeds of Zos Canyon in the Gobi Desert by the American Museum of Natural History and described by Diego Pol and Mark Norell in 2004.
facts.quote: It was found in the Redbeds of Zos Canyon (Djadokhta Formation) in the Gobi Desert of Mongolia by expeditions organized by the American Museum of Natural History, and described by palaeontologists Diego Pol and Mark Norell in 2004.

facts.statement: The only known species, Z. davidsoni, was named in honor of preparator Amy Davidson.
facts.quote: La especie tipo y única conocida es Z. davidsoni, en honor de Amy Davidson.

facts.statement: The fossil record consists of five specimens, including a holotype with an isolated skull and lower jaws.
facts.quote: Material of Z. davidsonae consists of five specimens: IGM 100/1305 (holotype): isolated skull and lower jaws IGM 100/1304 IGM 100/1306 IGM 100/1307 IGM 100/1308

facts.statement: Zosuchus lived during the Late Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: Zosuchus ("Zos [Canyon] crocodile") is a genus of basal, Late Cretaceous crocodyliform from Mongolia.

facts.statement: Zosuchus lived in the Redbeds of Zos Canyon within the Djadochta Formation of the Gobi Desert in Mongolia.
facts.quote: Zosuchus ("Cocodrilo de[l Cañón] Zos") es un género extinto de crocodiliforme basal que vivió en el Cretácico Superior en los Lechos rojizos del Cañón de Zos (Formación Djadochta) en el desierto de Gobi en Mongolia.

facts.statement: Zosuchus lived between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: A 2018 analysis placed Zosuchus within the basal mesoeucrocodyliform clade Shartegosuchoidea.
facts.quote: A 2018 cladistic analysis found Zosuchus, along with Sichuanosuchus, Shantungosuchus, and Shartegosuchidae, to form a basal mesoeucrocodyliform clade, Shartegosuchoidea.

facts.statement: Zosuchus belongs to the suborder Protosuchia within the order Crocodyliformes.
facts.quote: unranked_ordo: Crurotarsi superordo: Crocodylomorpha ordo: Crocodyliformes subordo: Protosuchia

facts.statement: Zosuchus is considered a terrestrial crocodyliform, distinct from modern crocodiles.
facts.quote: Zosuchus ("Zos [Canyon] crocodile") is a genus of basal, Late Cretaceous crocodyliform from Mongolia.

rejected.statement: Researchers classified Zosuchus as the sister taxon to Sichuanosuchus and Shantungosuchus based on a ventrally deflected posterior region of the mandibular rami.
rejected.quote: Pol & Norell (2004) found Zosuchus davidsoni to be sister to Sichuanosuchus and Shantungosuchus, the three forming a basal clade of crocodyliforms based on the presence of a ventrally deflected posterior region of the mandibular rami.
